title: Types of Alopecia: Every Kind of Hair Loss, Explained
seo_title: Types of Alopecia: Hair Loss Conditions Explained | FullyVital
seo_description: The main types of alopecia: pattern hair loss, telogen effluvium, alopecia areata, traction, trichotillomania and scarring alopecias. How to tell them apart.
summary_html: The main types of alopecia, how to tell them apart, which are autoimmune, and when to see a dermatologist.
notes: New hub for the conditions cluster (Phase 2 rule: 'informational, careful: one sourced hub, no product claims near disease content'). Targets 'types of alopecia' (3,600 a month), 'alopecia hair loss' (1,900), 'different types of alopecia' (1,000) and 'is alopecia inherited' (1,600).
No product claims or product links. One short 'A note on products' section says FullyVital products aren't treatments for these conditions.

FAQ built from Google's 'People also ask' for 'types of alopecia': which type is autoimmune, how to tell which you have, what can be mistaken for alopecia, what stage 4 means, plus whether alopecia is inherited.
3 studies: a 2024 American Family Physician review of hair loss, a 2018 review of scarring alopecias and a 2022 review of lichen planopilaris and frontal fibrosing alopecia.

After publishing, these removed pages redirect here: scarring alopecia (8,414 impressions), cicatricial alopecia (6,836), triangular alopecia (3,446), lichen planopilaris (2,562), frontal fibrosing alopecia (2,252), discoid lupus (1,614), trichotillomania (1,447), systemic lupus (1,032), alopecia mucinosa and /alopecia.
